Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a short historical decision note for the April 21, 2023 staff review. State what evidence was still required before the churn issue could be called fixed and when that evidence was expected.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Historical decision note — April 21, 2023 staff review", "body": "Date: April 21, 2023

Decision: Do not call the mid-segment churn issue fixed yet.

Evidence still required: Cohort 3 had to land and hold the favorable onboarding-trigger result. Staff viewed the leading hypothesis as still supported; cohort 2’s wobble appeared more consistent with a one-off Customer Success-side outage than with the fix failing, and signup-source and tier cuts remained clean. Even so, one favorable chart was not enough to establish that the improvement was durable.

Expected timing: Cohort 3 was expected the following week. The working position was “yes, if cohort 3 holds,” with any stronger board-call or victory-lap language deferred until then."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_010_01", "path": "args", "criterion": "The note says the churn issue would not be called fixed unless the third cohort supported the leading hypothesis, and that cohort was expected the following week. Decision: Do not call the mid-segment churn issue fixed yet.

Evidence still required: Cohort 3 had to land and hold the favorable onboarding-trigger result. Staff viewed the leading hypothesis as still supported; cohort 2’s wobble appeared more consistent with a one-off Customer Success-side outage than with the fix failing, and signup-source and tier cuts remained clean. Even so, one favorable chart was not enough to establish that the improvement was durable.

Expected timing: Cohort 3 was expected the following week. The working position was “yes, if cohort 3 holds,” with any stronger board-call or victory-lap language deferred until then."}}]}
